# Orchestrator self-check when stuck: verify each account one by one, clear stale jobs

Launched directly by Brett's request (voice) because the dispatcher is stuck. Orchestrator build record id (filed separately, will be marked built after): `orchestrator-self-check-when-stuck-verify-each-a`.

## Problem
The build pipeline (build-orchestrator plugin, pipeline-status) shows every queued build waiting with "no Claude account is signed in on the VPS" and an empty accounts list, while claude-accounts/list shows mossesx-max- (Max) active and signed in, account-3 (Hulu) saved, and API workers mossesx-api and account-5. The dispatcher's account view is out of sync with claude-workers / claude-login.

## Do
1. Find why pipeline-status `accounts` is empty and why the dispatcher thinks no account is signed in (compare build-orchestrator pipeline code with deploy/claude-workers.mjs and claude-login.mjs). Fix the root cause.
2. Self-check: on console load, on every dispatcher tick where queued builds wait with no launch, and on demand, the orchestrator checks each saved account one by one (subscription logins and API keys: signed in, limited, key valid, free slots), rebuilds its account list from that, and logs what it found.
3. Stale reaper: release running counts / slots / build records with no live tmux session or claude process; requeue or mark their builds. Overlaps pending builds fix-stale-running-counts-per-claude-account-not-cleared and real-time-slot-tracking-stale-data-reaper: fold in what fits.
4. Notify AmberX when the self-check fixes something or finds an account it can't use.
5. Expose the self-check as a control command (API/voice) and show its last result in the orchestrator UI.
6. Tests green, report in _claude/builds/reports/, THREADS row, commit, push, PR. Keep it small; stop and report if blocked.
